records.idealWeather: Cool, moist weather (10-15°C) with persistent fog/dew
symptoms: Yellow-orange powdery stripes on leaves parallel to veins
Leaves drying up and turning brown prematurely
Severely stunted plant growth with shriveled grain formation
symptomsHindi: पत्तियों पर पीले-नारंगी रंग की धारियाँ
पत्तियाँ सूखकर समय से पहले भूरी होना
अनाज के दाने सिकुड़ना और पौधे का विकास रुकना

immediate: Remove and burn infected leaves immediately to contain airborne spores
Drain standing water from the field
chemical: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml per litre of water
organic: Spray 5% aqueous Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or diluted Neem Oil (5ml/L)
Turmeric powder (5g/L) mixed with sour buttermilk spray as natural antifungal

prevention: Sow certified rust-resistant varieties like HD-2967, PBW-550, or DBW-187
Avoid excessive nitrogenous fertilization during vegetative phase

records.idealWeather: High humidity (>90%) with night temperatures around 20°C
symptoms: Diamond or spindle-shaped lesions with gray-white centres and brown margins
Neck rot causing panicles to fall over and turn white (empty grains)
symptomsHindi: पत्तियों पर नाव के आकार के धब्बे जिनका केंद्र सफेद-धूसर होता है
बाली की गर्दन सड़ना जिससे बालियां सफेद होकर गिर जाती हैं

immediate: Drain field water for 24-48 hours if possible
chemical: Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6g per litre of water
organic: Spray Cow urine solution (10% diluted) with fermented garlic extract
Pseudomonas fluorescens bio-agent @ 5g per litre of water

prevention: Seed treatment with Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2g/kg seed before sowing

records.idealWeather: Warm temperatures (24-29°C) with intermittent rain/heavy dew
symptoms: Concentric target-board rings on older lower leaves
Leaves turn yellow around spots and drop off defoliating the plant
symptomsHindi: निचली पत्तियों पर छल्लेदार (टारगेट जैसी) गोल भूरी धारियाँ
पत्तियाँ पीली होकर झड़ना जिससे फल धूप में झुलस जाते हैं

immediate: Prune lower infected foliage up to 12 inches from ground
Water only at the root base; avoid overhead sprinkler wetting
chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g per litre of water
organic: Baking soda spray (5g/L) with 2ml vegetable oil as surfactant

prevention: Follow 3-year crop rotation avoiding Solanaceae family plants
Mulch beds with dry paddy straw to prevent fungal soil splash
